diaspora_bullets: Dhoni, 45, will stay with CSK as Team Mentor from IPL 2027
CSK named no successor ahead of the December 16 auction in Goa
hook_line: DHONI ENDS 19-YEAR IPL CAREER, STAYS AS CSK MENTOR

hook_stat.sub: IPL career that began in the inaugural season in 2008

news_summary: Chennai Super Kings announced on Tuesday, November 17, that MS Dhoni has retired from the IPL as a player and will begin a new chapter with the franchise as Team Mentor from IPL 2027.
payoff: Dhoni will still be in the CSK dugout when IPL 2027 begins — in the mentor's seat, not at the toss.

stats.label: IPL titles as CSK captain — 2010, 2011, 2018, 2021 and 2023
